root: Core biological logic layer: DNA utilities, sequence I/O, annotation model, primer design, assembly validation, and all enzyme databases — the app's domain engine.
store: Monolithic Zustand+Immer store composed of 7 flat slices: projects, library entries, canvas nav, workspace router, primers, UI preferences, annotator, and common-features overlay.
AppShell: Thin content-area frame + workspace router that switches between Library, DAG, and Importer via store.workspace.active.
StartScreen: App home/dashboard screen: project list, sidebar nav, file drop zone, and help popover — mounted by App.jsx as the 'start' fullscreen surface.
components/Dag: Fullscreen project-level DAG view: library palette + drag-to-canvas + ReactFlow node graph of plasmid containers with auto-layout.
CanvasSkeleton: Self-contained four-tier assembly workbench (canvas + editor + operations + zones) with isolated useReducer state, persisted per-project to IndexedDB.
Toast: Fixed-position notification stack rendering ephemeral success/error/warning/info toasts with optional undo action and auto-dismiss.
lib: Cross-cutting service layer: I/O serialization (.bodge ZIP v1/v2), persistence (IndexedDB/localStorage), annotation editing, sequence search, UI strings, hotkeys, DAG layout, and bio algorithms.
components/Library: Full-screen Library workspace: file/paste import pipeline, entry browser with project/loose/trash tree, and multi-tab sequence inspector.
canvas: Lab notebook UI (split-edit + markdown preview) and project export modal — ready-to-mount but not yet wired into the main app.
hooks: App-level React hooks extracting side-effects, fragment mutation logic, sequence selection state, and markdown ref resolution from App.jsx.
components/Annotator: Fullscreen/embedded multi-level annotation orchestrator: runs plugin pipeline, surfaces ghost predictions, and lets the user accept/reject/edit them before committing to a fragment.
SequenceView: Interactive linear DNA sequence viewer: per-line tracks (primer/RE/ruler/strands/annotation/AA), overlays, and edit operations.
db: Single-file Dexie/IndexedDB persistence layer: schema versioning (v1-v6) + CRUD helpers for all 6 tables.
components/(legacy v0.5 singletons + mis: 33 flat-directory components forming the entire assembly-canvas interaction layer: wizards, junction controls, plasmid viewers, protocol tracking, and app-level modals.
